findings: The V2 independent activation-review PASS effect incorrectly sets formal_execution_authorized=true, so reviewer approval is not separated from explicit user formal-run authority while the frozen formal config remains closed.

The V2 outer does not freeze the complete project-code execution import closure; runtime self-hashes can accept mutually consistent post-review drift in resource, process-identity, termination, commit, science, and worker dependencies.

The V2 focused tests do not exercise a real four-stage handshake through science release or the required ACK, READY, closure-drift, post-release-exit, root-observation, and PID/create-time failure matrix.
